title: Chinese memory CXMT not a cheap alternative as Samsung launches SSD amid price crisis
summary: DDR5 modules from Chinese manufacturer align with prices of major market players, while Samsung introduces a new PCIe 4.0 SSD amid global memory price increases.

title: United States weighs restrictions on Chinese artificial intelligence as global debate intensifies
summary: The US studies selective bans on Chinese open-source models, while Jensen Huang warns about global dependence on scientists from the Asian country and a map shows AI dominance by region.

title: AI security questioned after OpenAI hack and ChatGPT jailbreaks
summary: While the community demands radical transparency after the cyberattack on OpenAI, new defenses against malicious prompt injection emerge as attempts to obtain biological weapons recipes are discovered.

title: Platforms bet on artificial intelligence for creators to generate and monetize content
summary: YouTube integrates an AI to design video thumbnails, while micro-drama platforms allow creating and monetizing short series generated by artificial intelligence.

title: Retro emulation scene advances with milestones in PSP, PS5, and discovery of rare Famicombox
summary: A developer manages to run Counter-Strike on a PSP, the PS5 emulator accesses the GTA V menu, and a strange Nintendo Famicombox console appears in Japan allowing 15 titles to be played at once.

title: Enthusiasts combine gaming and professional GPUs in hybrid PCs to run AI and games
summary: Two projects show how to build systems that integrate from a Tesla V100 for language models to frame generation combining an RTX 3090 with an RTX 3050.
